home.title: The Quran Companion
home.subtitle: Find a committed partner to memorize and revise the Quran, online or near you.

guide.title: How it works
guide.s1d: With Google or your email, in a few seconds.
guide.s2d: Level, recitation, surahs, hizb memorized and availability. City and country only.
guide.s3d: Filter by level, language, country, schedule… with a same-gender-only option.
guide.s4d: Your WhatsApp is shared only after the request is accepted.
guide.s5d: Then set your status to “Partner found”.
guide.s6d: Reviews build trust. Every report is checked by the administrator.

hadith.text: “Keep refreshing your bond with this Quran. By the One in whose hand is the soul of Muhammad, it slips away faster than a camel from its tether.”

auth.forgot_text: Enter your email: you will receive a link to choose a new password.
auth.pw_rule: At least 8 characters, with letters and numbers.
auth.check_email: Account created. Open the link sent to your email to confirm your address.
auth.reset_sent: If this address is registered, a link has just been sent.

err.pw_rule: The password must have at least 8 characters, with letters and numbers.
err.pw_mismatch: The two passwords do not match.
err.not_confirmed: Address not confirmed. Open the link sent to your email.
err.rate_limit: Too many attempts. Try again in a few minutes.
err.google_off: Google sign-in is not available yet.
err.same_password: Choose a password different from the old one.
err.generic: Something went wrong. Please try again.
err.required: Please fill in all required fields.
err.surah_order: The starting surah must come before the ending surah.
err.guardian: The guardian's name and WhatsApp are required.

profile.wa_private: Shared only after a request is accepted.
profile.pause_hint: It no longer appears in searches.

edit.intro: This information helps find the right partner. Only your city and country are shown, never your address.
edit.whatsapp_hint: With country code. Never public: shared only after acceptance.
edit.guardian_note: Under 18: contact goes through a parent or guardian.
